fields.name: summary.amount
fields.type: number (integer Naira, snapshot of dmPrice at send time)

fields.name: refundedAt
fields.note: present only while summary.status === refunded; read into the type but not actually rendered by [threadId]/page.tsx (it recomputes its own refund copy from summary.status/amount instead)

filtersOrSort: looked up by threadId route param

fields.name: threads[].opened
fields.note: true once buyer opened it; starts the 24h window per comment

filtersOrSort: client-side: threads split into urgent (!opened) vs answered (opened) via Array.filter, not requested as separate params
reads.pagination: none — full state object fetched whole

fields.name: messages[].attachmentName
fields.note: display-only filename; no upload/download endpoint backs it anywhere in the API layer

filtersOrSort: client-side sortThreads(): status rank (awaiting < answered < refunded), then ascending deadlineMinutes within awaiting
reads.pagination: none — full thread list with full message history fetched in one call, no page/cursor param

fields.name: creator.tier
fields.note: read via currentSession.creator?.tier ?? "basic" fallback, then used to index the static PLANS map for the revenue-split percentage

reads.note: Read by direct import of the mock session singleton (`import { currentSession } from "@/lib/api/mocks/session"`) in both Inbox.tsx and QuestionsDesktop.tsx, bypassing src/lib/api/ entirely and bypassing creatorGates() — no SEAM comment covers this read, and it is not one of the domain API functions. This is the mechanism the screen uses to compute 'earn X' amounts (price * PLANS[tier].split / 100); the split percentage itself is a static client-side constant (types/subscription.ts PLANS), never fetched, so the backend contract for 'what does replying to this specific paid message actually earn me' is entirely reconstructed client-side rather than returned by any read.

payload.name: amount
payload.type: number (integer Naira, equals creator.dmPrice at send time)

actions.name: reportDmIssue
actions.note: STUB-8: implemented as a local component-level simulated round trip (reportMockDmIssue in DmThreadFooter.tsx) with no dm.ts/mocks-dm.ts export at all, unlike every other action on this screen — genuinely net-new endpoint, no existing pattern to mirror.

actions.name: replyToThread
actions.note: Mock effect: pushes a { from: "creator", text } message, flips status to "answered", clears deadlineMinutes/deadlineLabel — implies this is also the action that 'releases the held payment' per the UI copy, though no separate payment-release read/response field exists; the split-adjusted earn amount is computed purely client-side (price * PLANS[tier].split / 100), never returned by this call.

rolesObserved: user (fan) — opens/continues a paid DM thread via DmPaySheet and sendPaidDm, sends a Tip via TipSheet, reads their own DM thread detail
creator — answers paid questions via Inbox.tsx (mobile) / QuestionsDesktop.tsx + QuestionDetail.tsx (desktop), replyToThread
authContext.note: messages/page.tsx renders the creator-facing Inbox and QuestionsDesktop components unconditionally, with no account-type or creatorGates() check anywhere in this screen's files gating which view a session sees — a plain 'user' account visiting /messages would still be shown the creator's paid-questions inbox UI in the current code, since Inbox.tsx/QuestionsDesktop.tsx never check currentSession.accountType. Separately, both components read currentSession.creator.dmPrice/tier by direct mock-module import rather than through creatorGates() or an API call, contrary to CLAUDE.md's 'Creator gates come from creatorGates() ... never re-check inline' rule.

specialNotes: No polling/websocket: every fetch is on-mount only (getState/getThreads on mount, no interval/focus-refresh), matching conventions.md's 'no websockets in this build' decision.
No pagination anywhere on this screen: DM thread messages, the mobile inbox, and the desktop three-pane thread list are all fetched as complete arrays in a single call.

QuestionDetail.tsx renders a Paperclip icon button in the reply composer with no onClick handler and no upload call wired — decorative only. Buyer messages can carry a display-only ThreadMessage.attachmentName string (e.g. "quote-two-schools.pdf", seeded in messaging.ts) but nothing links it to a real file — no upload endpoint exists for a buyer to attach a file to a paid question, and no download/view action exists for the creator to open the named attachment.

uiStatesDesignedNotes: Frame '1 · Entry on her profile — price and promise together' in WAWU Paid DM.dc.html, and Creator DM Earnings frames 1 (Settings), 5 (Earnings), 6 (KYC pending) are excluded here — they belong to the profile-own-and-public, messages-settings, and earnings/kyc screens respectively, not messages-dm.

No design frame anywhere in WAWU Marketplace Tips.dc.html specifies a tip-failure state — the design source only shows choose/sheet/sent (frames 6-8). TipSheet.tsx's 'failure' phase (and its accompanying copy 'Nothing was charged. Try again, or pick a different amount.') has no corresponding designed frame at all, on top of being unreachable via the current mock (see tip-sheet-failure above).

No design frame specifies a 'refunded' state for the desktop QuestionDetail/paid-questions-inbox view (D8's frame only shows awaiting + answered rows) — consistent with question-detail-refunded being coded but unreachable and unseeded in mock data.
